title: Use a previs workflow (プレビズ戦法) when producing a complex single-shot in Seedance…
content:
Use a previs workflow (プレビズ戦法) when producing a complex single-shot in Seedance 2.5  
Use Unreal Engine animation assets as part of your workflow to help drive/guide motion for Seedance 2.5 shots  
Use many reference materials (e.g., 41 references) to help control a large number of characters (e.g., 32 people) in a single Seedance 2.5 shot  
Focus on matching audio timing (音ハメ) during editing to sync the generated video to sound

在使用 Seedance 2.5 制作复杂的单镜头时，采用 previs 工作流（プレビズ戦法）  
将 Unreal Engine 动画素材纳入工作流程，帮助驱动/引导 Seedance 2.5 镜头中的运动  
使用大量参考素材（例如 41 个参考）来帮助控制单个 Seedance 2.5 镜头中的大量角色（例如 32 人）  
在剪辑时注重匹配音频节奏（音ハメ），让生成的视频与声音同步
